`python3 budget.py 2026-09` now counts only September's transactions, and with no month the envelope figures are the same as before.

I ran it against your data:

| Envelope | No month | `2026-08` | `2026-09` |
|---|---|---|---|
| groceries | 174.60 | 403.05 | 371.55 |
| fuel | 22.85 | 78.10 | 124.75 |
| eating out | 45.75 | 111.50 | 84.25 |
| household | 54.61 | 73.01 | 101.60 |

- **Extra line on stderr:** every run now prints a line like `counted 6 of 12 transactions` to stderr. I added it because a mistyped month such as `2062-09` otherwise looks like a healthy, untouched budget. It also appears when no month is given; stdout is unchanged, so piping the report elsewhere is unaffected.
- **Bad input:** a malformed month (`sept`, `2026-13`) or a second argument exits with code 2 and a usage message instead of producing a report.

The change is all in `budget.py`.
